## New
- Swipe a notification to the right to save its video to Watch Later, or long-press it for more options (#1363)
- Music speed now goes up to 4x with the same speed control as videos (#1346)
- Podcasts and other long tracks can resume where you stopped, from a new switch in Settings, Playback (#1346)

## Improved
- Videos and Shorts are turned down to YouTube's loudness level, so loud uploads no longer play louder than the rest (#1335)
- Picture-in-picture now starts automatically when you leave a playing video
- Playback settings show whether the equalizer is on (#1335)

## Fixed
- Stable Voice made every video 6 dB louder; it is replaced by Normalize volume (#1335)
